meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按统一契约搭建可稳定渲染的动画合成项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用标记语言制作动画或视频,需要每次渲染结果一致。
copy.tagline_en: Build animation compositions that render identically on every run
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you author animation or video in markup and need consistent renders

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 的合成规范编写 HTML:用 data-* 属性声明时间、注册唯一的可暂停时间线、由框架负责媒体播放,产出可渲染成一个视频项目的文件,并遵守确定性渲染与校验规则。
howto.when: 当你编写或修改合成 HTML,涉及 data-* 时间属性、轨道、子合成等配置时触发;原文要求写合成 HTML 之前先读它。

howto.what_en: Claude writes HTML per the HyperFrames composition contract: timing via data-* attributes, one paused timeline registered, framework-owned media playback — producing one renderable project and following determinism and validation rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write or edit composition HTML, covering data-* timing attributes, tracks, sub-compositions and more. The doc says to read it before writing composition HTML.
